tools.name: list_competitions
tools.description: Basketball competitions that have upcoming games with odds, with the number of games in each. Use it to find the exact competition name for the other tools.

tools.name: list_games
tools.description: Upcoming games in one competition with each bookmaker's main moneyline, handicap (spread, line = home team's handicap) and total, in decimal odds. Full game only unless include_periods is true.

tools.name: get_game
tools.description: One game by id with every bookmaker's main lines for every period. Works for finished games too, returning their closing odds.

tools.name: get_game_history
tools.description: Every price change for a game, newest first (Data plan). Use it for line movement and closing odds.

tools.name: list_discrepancies
tools.description: The biggest cross-bookmaker differences on main lines for upcoming games: moneyline prices, handicap lines and totals (Pro and Data plans).

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: The bookmakers covered and when each was last collected.
